name: air-wallet
description: Air Wallet — cross-platform digital wallet (web, Android, iOS) on Expo + Firebase

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck --prefix functions
scripts.emulators: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-air-wallet --import=.emulator-data --export-on-exit
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-air-wallet --only firestore "npm run test:rules --prefix functions"
